behavior: Only an explicit idle-timer Start can create this music/ad handoff. Music browsing, choosing, saving and explicit Play remain independent of Sync accounts and advertising.
Verified Pro, unknown entitlement, missing reusable consent or incomplete native SDK preparation do not enter a new music pause, consent, SDK initialization or ad request through this path.
The exact owned music queue acknowledges native pause before only its own ad blocker is yielded. Queue ownership, cue silence and other features’ blockers remain held.
Cached consent/SDK readiness is restored under the existing preparation hold. No fresh UMP form or native SDK initialization is started at this boundary.

At most one creative readiness wait lasts up to 1500 ms. Existing two-action spacing, 120-second cooldown, retries and creative age remain unchanged. A late load never presents after the Start opportunity.
A native show request resolving does not count as dismissal. Existing native CLOSED or terminal ERROR is required before music or timer continuation.
The music blocker is restored before conditional resume. Only the original current account/queue/user intent can resume; an originally paused queue stays paused.
Expected ad-related iOS inactive is distinguished from real background. Pause, Stop, Next, new queue, account/routine changes, blur and disposal cancel stale Start/resume continuation.
A checked failed or cancelled restore is carried into the Session action result and cannot silently start the session.
Active, paused or Rest-session toggles and Finish retain their existing paths. Music metadata and artwork are not passed to native ad request options.
scopeLimits: Native outputs in automated integration tests are controlled fakes; no live ad, physical iPhone MusicKit or new native-boundary delivery is claimed.
Actual ad availability, prior consent, account eligibility and existing cadence can skip an ad; this is not a guarantee of an ad on every Start.
No native files, dependencies, capabilities, release flags, backend schemas or storage keys changed.
The prior d7a22d1 simulator validation is separate from this new JS delta, which still requires its own overlay/UI check.
